verdicts.note: Collage: monastery church with dome and cloister, cross portal, ruins on lawn, craggy cliffs, the town in the valley.
Historic B/W photo: ruined vaulted gate and church tower with a palm behind, rubble in the street, Tepoztlan in the 1940s.
Close-up of a meal: dark corn tortillas with melted cheese, rice and coriander on a wooden table.

verdicts.file: Vista de la ciudad de Tepoztlán desde la pirámide del Tepozteco.jpg
verdicts.note: View from the Tepozteco rock pyramid down over the town and the surrounding craggy mountain ridge.

verdicts.file: Joven baila brake dance en Tepoztlán.jpg
verdicts.note: Young people on a street, one breakdancing before a barred storefront with a Spanish poster.

verdicts.file: Iglesia la Santísima Trinidad Tepoztlán por Silvia.webp
verdicts.note: Weathered stone church with clock between two bell towers, papel picado flags and flower pots at the portal.
Tall mossy limestone rock towers rising above dense green forest, birds in flight.
Sunlit forested rock mountains with a notched ridge above the trees, blue sky.
Sunrise disc behind a dark band of trees and hills; almost nothing of the site is recognisable.
Visitors with cameras on an old cobbled path between mossy rock walls of the cliff.
View from a rock summit over the town of Tepoztlan in the valley between brown ridges.
Street with parked cars and restaurants (Los Colorines, Casa Rosa) directly under the bare rock cliff.
Typical cobbled street with a white VW beetle, old cars, an Antojitos shop and a Mexican flag.
Panorama over Tepoztlan from the cliffs, the town spread in the valley, dry hills behind.
Market stall of souvenirs: pottery, glass tumblers printed TEPOZTLAN, pipes and wooden figures.
Inside a church: stone baptismal font and benches, painted vaulted ceiling and side altars.

verdicts.file: Saxofonista tocando en la calle del Tepozteco, Tepoztlán, Morelos.jpg
verdicts.note: Saxophonist playing by a yellow-and-blue church under papel picado; street sign points to the Tepozteco.
Dense tropical forest over rock walls; no structure or monument of the site recognisable.

verdicts.file: Imágenes elaboradas colectivamente con semillas de arroz, frijol, maíz, garbanzo y lenteja para la fiesta de la Natividad de la Virgen (Tepoztlán, Morelos, México) del 8 de septiembre de cada año (foto 7 de 14).jpg
verdicts.note: Macro shot of a bead and seed embroidery of a saint, made of rice, bean and maize seeds.
